collections.label: Winter trips
collections.title: Kashmir winter journeys
collections.description: Snow-country stays, pine-framed roads and slower valley days. Explore group adventures, women-only trips and a private honeymoon, with routes shaped around winter access.
advice: Choose December to February for a winter-focused plan; snowfall is never guaranteed.
Agree room heating, hot water, winter transport and weather alternatives in your quote.
Gondola tickets, snow activities and local vehicles are optional unless specifically included.

collections.label: Women-only trips
collections.title: Kashmir, together.
collections.description: From winter in Gulmarg to summer in Gurez and Warwan, find a women-only Kashmir route with a pace and room-sharing arrangement that suits you.
advice: Ask about the group date, room sharing and named support before booking.
Female trip leadership can be requested; staffing is confirmed in your written quote.
Winter valleys and summer mountain circuits have different access windows.

collections.label: Honeymoon trips
collections.title: A little time for two.
collections.description: A private Kashmir winter honeymoon with lake evenings, unhurried mountain stays and space to celebrate your way. Adapt the route to your dates and preferred comforts.
advice: Choose room categories and heating arrangements before accepting the quote.
Private dinners, decorations and photography can be requested as separately priced extras.
Add a rest day or a different season to make the route your own.

collections.label: Group trips
collections.title: Good places. Shared journeys.
collections.description: Discover Kashmir, Ladakh and Jammu with routes for valley explorers, seasonal travellers and people who enjoy sharing the journey.
advice: Select a route, then request a group departure date.
Group size, pickup arrangements and support are agreed before booking.
Suggested dates are planning ideas until availability is confirmed.

collections.label: Private holidays
collections.title: Your people. Your pace.
collections.description: Plan a Kashmir or Jammu holiday around your family, your partner or your own small group, with room to choose the stays and experiences you love.
advice: Tell us your preferred comfort level and room arrangement.
Transport type, meal plan and optional experiences are itemised in the quote.
Extend a stay or simplify the route to leave more room for downtime.

collections.label: Treks & walks
collections.title: Take the scenic way.
collections.description: Explore Kashmir’s alpine lakes, waterfall walks and mountain ridges, with shorter outings and longer trekking proposals for different experience levels.
advice: Choose a route suited to your experience and the season.
Agree equipment, guide arrangements, camp facilities and contingency plans before booking.
Trek access and permissions must be checked for your dates.

collections.label: Motorcycle trips
collections.title: Roads worth remembering.
collections.description: Ride through Ladakh’s highland scenery on routes planned for experienced, licensed riders, with arrival rest and time to discuss support and rental arrangements.
advice: Confirm licence eligibility, riding experience and rental terms first.
Agree the motorcycle model, riding gear, fuel, support and liability in writing.
High passes and remote sections depend on seasonal road access.

collections.label: Heritage & faith
collections.title: Stories. Craft. Sacred places.
collections.description: Spend time with Kashmir’s old-city heritage, living arts and religious traditions, or follow a focused faith journey through Srinagar and Jammu.
advice: Choose a heritage route or a journey focused on your own faith tradition.
Visits depend on opening hours, worship schedules and permission.
Museum and craft visits can be requested without an obligation to buy.
